name: Pipeliners - Full SEO Baseline Audit 2026-07-23
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-07-23

# Summary
A read-only audit across every Search Atlas module (OTTO, Site Audit, Site Explorer, Rank Tracker, GBP, Citations, LLM Visibility, Local Heatmaps). Two versions exist: `pipelinersusa-full-seo-audit-2026-07-22.pdf` (9 pages) and the corrected `pipelinersusa-full-seo-audit-2026-07-23.pdf` (11 pages), which leads with measured GSC data instead of Site Explorer estimates.

# Key findings (July 23 version)
- **GSC, 90 days to Jul 22:** 98 clicks, 58,060 impressions, 0.40% CTR, position 28.4 (US 86 clicks, 0.15% CTR, position 47.1). Desktop 46,249 impressions, mobile 13,323.
- **Highest-impression pages, zero clicks:** /what-is-cipp/ 7,263 at position 74, the CIPP "how plumbers use" post 4,819, /glendale/ 3,513, reline vs replace 2,848, /phoenix/ 2,418, /tempe/ 2,072, /buckeye/ 1,726, /mesa/ 1,570. Only the homepage earns clicks (28).
- /epoxy-pipe-lining/ lost 58 clicks period over period.
- Site Explorer (modelled): 428 keywords, about 927 visits a month, about 10x optimistic versus GSC; 800 of the visits are the brand term. Of 289 classified keywords only 14 are transactional and they drive 0 traffic. 59% of keywords sit at positions 51-100.
- Backlinks 1,147 from 312 domains, mostly auto-generated junk. GBP 95.24% complete, 122 reviews at 4.99, 100% replied. Local pack coverage 17 of 180 SERPs (9.4%). AI share of voice 32%, rank #1.
- Stale Yoast sitemaps (page-sitemap, post-sitemap) registered in GSC should be removed.

# Conclusion in the report
Demand reaches the pages but titles, positions and intent fail to convert it; this is a content and CTR problem more than a crawl problem.
